clues: This village sits in the foothills of high mountains in Japan. It lies in the north part of a famous range of snowy peaks.
This place gets huge amounts of snow each year. One winter set a new record for the most snow here in a single season.
This village was the main place for the 1998 Winter Games. Ski races, ski jumps, and cross country races all took place here.
Ten ski resorts share this one valley, with more than two hundred runs to choose from. This village is the hub at the heart of them all.
Walkers set out from here to climb two famed peaks. Both peaks sit on a list of one hundred great mountains in Japan.
